references.text: Mentions Baalah as the starting point of the boundary line that continues in verse 10
Describes the same boundary from the perspective of the tribe of Benjamin and mentions Kiriath-jearim (Har-jearim)
Mentions Timnah as a city in the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, the same place where the boundary passes
Beth-shemesh is mentioned as a Levitical city in the territory of the tribe of Judah
Timnah is mentioned in connection with the story of Samson, the same place where the boundary passed
Beth-shemesh plays an important role when the ark of the covenant is returned from the Philistines
Beth-shemesh and Timnah are mentioned as cities that the Philistines captured from Judah
